words: On Saturday I walked into a room full of founders with one thing. A six minute pitch.
I pitched AskVerb to a founder who has already raised a Series B. I was given ten minutes. We talked for fifteen.
And I made the next round. Leap by Masai's Founders' Cohort. It starts in Goa and ends in Bengaluru, pitching to investors.
I don't have the money for it right now. Still, I left with something better than a seat.
Don't build for every SaaS yet. Start where the workflow is so complex that only a few people know how it works, and nothing is written down.
I heard from VCs and founders, met people building all kinds of things, and that same day, four people signed up. My second best day so far.
